_meta.title: Error codes
_meta.description: Frozen at M0 from contracts/result-schemas.md's error table (PRD §10). This is reference data (the fixed set of exception classes both implementations must define), not a JSON Schema for validating instances. Fixed set — do not add a code without a constitution/plan-level review (Principle VII, 'no new component' discipline).

codes.condition: No suitable provider configured for a model-requiring operation; also raised at open() for an invalid config such as a missing application_namespace under Redis mode
Invalid/oversize ingest batch; import manifest/record-count mismatch
codes.required_behavior: Raise typed error; no partial commit

codes.condition: Same ingest key, different request hash

codes.required_behavior: Raise; never a fake empty/successful history

codes.condition: Loaded SQLite runtime fails required version/feature check
Stale generation at tree-publish commit; stale generation at read emission when a concurrent clear_history invalidated an in-flight retrieve()/ask()
codes.required_behavior: Discard/retry bounded, or raise; never emit or cache a stale-generation result

codes.condition: Budget exhausted before useful work; clear_history quiescence deadline exceeded
codes.required_behavior: Raise; no forced final synthesis / no completion claimed
Stop dispatching, propagate, close resources, cache nothing incomplete
